literal: Support having-realized, attachment to-perish if-one-behaves, again having-destroyed will-not-approach approaching suffering.
translation: If one realizes the true support and lives so that worldly attachments perish, the sufferings that usually approach will not come to destroy one again.
modern: உண்மையான சார்பினை உணர்ந்து, உலகப் பற்றுக்கள் அழியுமாறு வாழ்ந்தால், இயல்பாக வந்து சேரும் துன்பங்கள் மீண்டும் வந்து அழித்துச் சேராது.
explanation: The word 'cārpu' is used twice with two different meanings: first as the ultimate truth or true support, and second as worldly attachments. If a person realizes the true support and conducts their life in a way that severs worldly attachments, they are freed from sorrow. The sufferings ('nōy') that naturally approach all beings will not return to destroy such a person again.
